description: This file contains implementation of sparse matrix operations optimized with MKL in the context of PyTorch's ATen library. It includes functions for preparing tensors for MKL, converting indices to MKL compatible formats, performing sparse matrix-matrix and matrix-vector multiplications, addition, and triangular solve routines specifically for sparse CSR matrices. The code interacts heavily with MKL-specific types and functions, and implements logic for handling different tensor layouts and data types.

methods.name: c10::MaybeOwned<Tensor> prepare_dense_matrix_for_mkl(const Tensor & tensor)
methods.description: Prepares a dense tensor for MKL operations, ensuring tensor is non-overlapping, dense, and in a compatible memory format (contiguous or batched column major).

methods.name: c10::MaybeOwned<Tensor> prepare_dense_matrix_for_mkl(const Tensor & tensor,bool row_major)
methods.description: Overloaded function that additionally takes a boolean 'row_major' to prepare a tensor with specific memory layout for MKL.

methods.name: c10::MaybeOwned<Tensor> prepare_dense_vector_for_mkl(const Tensor & tensor)
methods.description: Prepares a dense vector tensor for MKL operations, cloning if necessary to ensure contiguous representation.

methods.name: void indices_to_mkl_compatible_inplace(const Tensor & input)
methods.description: Converts the indices tensors of a sparse CSR tensor in-place to MKL-compatible format, depending on whether MKL uses ILP64 or LP64 interface.

methods.name: void col_indices_and_values_resize_(const Tensor & input,int64_t nnz)
methods.description: Resizes the col_indices and values tensors of a CSR sparse tensor to match the number of nonzeros (nnz).

methods.name: void mkl_result_copy_(const Tensor & input,sparse_matrix_t mkl_desc)
methods.description: Copies the MKL-produced CSR matrix data back into a Tensor, resizing col_indices and values accordingly.

methods.name: void addmm_dense_result(const Tensor & A,const Tensor & B,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,const Tensor & C)
methods.description: Performs sparse-dense matrix multiplication and adds the result to an output tensor, utilizing MKL; handles different memory layouts.

methods.name: void addmm_sparse_input_dense_result(const Tensor & A,const Tensor & B,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,const Tensor & C)
methods.description: Performs sparse-sparse matrix multiplication resulting in dense output using MKL, with handling for empty matrices and batching.

methods.name: void addmm_sparse_result(const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,const Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs sparse matrix multiplication on CSR matrices and adds scaled result to an existing sparse matrix, copying data from MKL descriptors.

methods.name: void addmm_out_sparse_csr(const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,const Tensor & result)
methods.description: Main driver for sparse CSR matrix-matrix multiplication (addmm), selects implementation based on tensor layouts.

methods.name: void addmv_out_sparse_csr(const Tensor & mat,const Tensor & vec,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,const Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs sparse CSR matrix-vector multiplication (addmv), preparing tensors for MKL, and calling MKL sparse mv function.

methods.name: void add_out_sparse_csr(const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & alpha,const Tensor & result)
methods.description: Adds two sparse CSR matrices with scaling, utilizing MKL functions and handling different index data types.

methods.name: void triangular_solve_out_sparse_csr(const Tensor & A_,const Tensor & B,const Tensor & X,bool upper,bool transpose,bool unitriangular)
methods.description: Performs sparse triangular solve for CSR matrices using MKL, handling cases with unmaterialized diagonal indices and different input shapes.
